  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `tg_marker_ids` calls `capture($re)` without try/catch, so one trusted-author comment that does not match the exact-body regex aborts the whole snapshot jq and disables cleanup. (Used at lines 394-396, 480-485, 562-566.)
  WHY: Cleanup becomes a no-op while such a comment exists. Disagreement: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash states that jq `capture` yields an empty stream on no match instead of erroring.

- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:~305-330 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_tg_tracking_author_login` does not cache a failed lookup, so the lookup and warning repeat on each call.
  WHY: The cost is up to 2 extra `/user` attempts plus a duplicate warning per call. There is no incorrect trust decision, and the no-caching is documented.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=2

  Evidence of absence: The failure could not be tied to the diff. The test file is not in the changed-files list and does not reference the changed functions. Thirteen other tests failed on the merge-base too, so it is probably flaky or inherited.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:305-330 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In `_tg_tracking_author_login`, failed identity lookups are not cached.
  WHY: After a failure only `_TG_TRACKING_AUTHOR_CURRENT` is set, so later calls re-run the API lookup and re-print the warning. This floods logs and violates the documented once-per-process behavior.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=3
  Requirement: Pre-push gate passes with no new failures introduced by this change.
  Expected change site: tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py (or scripts/tg_helpers.sh interaction)
  Evidence of absence: The PR flags this test as failing because of the change. The regression is likely linked to the new `_tg_tracking_author_login` curl to https://api.github.com/user, which may be blocked or unauthenticated in the test environment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:303-331 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The once-per-process cache is populated only on a successful `/user` resolution. The fallback leaves `_TG_TRACKING_AUTHOR_LOGIN` unset, so each call re-runs the lookup and the warning.
  WHY: This wastes API quota and adds warning noise, and it contradicts the changelog's "resolved once per process" claim.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:273-274 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `tg_marker_ids` uses `capture($re)` without try/catch. A trusted-author body that fails the exact-body regex aborts the whole snapshot jq (used at lines 394-396, 480-485, 562-566).
  WHY: The snapshot returns 1 and `tg_cleanup_msgs` / `tg_cleanup_phase_msgs` return 0 without processing anything, so one malformed trusted comment silently disables cleanup.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: The pre-push test gate must pass with no new failures introduced by this change.
  Expected change site: `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py`, or a regression in `scripts/tg_helpers.sh` (the new `GET https://api.github.com/user` at line 317, or the `::warning::` at line 328).
  Evidence of absence: The diff does not modify the test file, the workflow YAML it reads, or `scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh`. No test in the audit file exercises the new code paths.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:305-330 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Failed identity lookups are not cached. The fallback is assigned only to `_TG_TRACKING_AUTHOR_CURRENT` at line 329, while the cache check at line 305 only checks `_TG_TRACKING_AUTHOR_LOGIN`.
  WHY: With an installation token that consistently cannot access `/user`, each tracking-helper call repeats the identity request and warning, adding avoidable API calls and log noise.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  WHY: If the result is a flake or misattribution, a green-run requirement is applied to an unrelated test. If it is real, the failing assertion must be reproduced before merge.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:305-331 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Failed identity lookups are not cached, so on a persistent 403 every store or cleanup call repeats up to 2 `GET /user` attempts and the `::warning::`.
  WHY: `tg_send_tracked` calls `tg_store_msg_id` once per tracked message, so one run can issue many redundant lookups. This contradicts the changelog's "resolved once per process" claim, though the retry is documented as deliberate.

  PROBLEM: There is no contract break. Signatures and call sites are unchanged. Behavior drift for legacy non-exact markers is intentional and degrades safely to creating a fresh marker.
  WHY: The drift is documented in the changelog fragment.
- TASK_GAP (none found) | severity=NIT | confidence=5

  Expected change site: scripts/tg_helpers.sh; tests/test_tg_helpers_cleanup.py, tests/test_tracking_comment_cap.py
